data.body: Correction follow-up: dropped enduring-ironclad-arrowana from my active assignment and read its merged Gerrit 2807 change first. That change trims long-lived plan-review relation snapshots to subject/direct child/prerequisite rows; it materially lowers retained review memory, but it does not touch autodeploy, nginx upstream selection, Docker restart behavior, or the failure mode where nginx remains pinned to an exited MCP backend. The barracuda reproduction therefore remains valid post-2807: tests simulate the residual serving-path fault directly (exited managed backend on nginx's live port) and prove it recovers via the merged in-place watchdog rather than persistent 502. Barracuda is already closed preexisting via Gerrit 2825.
